verdict.rationale: Shopify can be driven programmatically without its UI. Code obtains scoped access tokens for the Admin API, webhooks can trigger automated actions, and an official CLI handles apps, themes and storefronts, so scripted automation is plausible. However, nothing in the evidence documents running the CLI non-interactively or inside CI pipelines. Missing for 10: documented CI/non-interactive CLI usage (e.g. token-based CLI auth for pipelines, CI examples), explicit headless automation guides, independent or hands-on corroboration of CI workflows.
